IncBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Service 'model-runner-prod' elevated 5xx rate detected (18% error rate, spike start 2799991108). Auto-escalation to oncall. Pager sent to SRE Oncall - Ben.

SRE Oncall - Ben: I'm on it. what's the symptom?

Alice (eng-runtime): We're seeing repeated runtime panics from model-runner processes on several hosts, followed by OOM kills on the GPU container. Logs show repeated segfaults in the quantized kernel path. Example from host gpu-23: `runtime: panic: double free` then `kernel: nvml oom killer invoked`.

Dave (eng-sre): Error streams: gateway returning 502/503 to clients. 5xxs correlate with requests that have long prompt lengths (>=5k tokens) and bursts.

Carla (support): Support tickets bubbling up—three enterprise customers seeing timeouts; two reported failed embeddings calls. Flagging as potentially high customer impact.

SRE Oncall - Ben: Initial mitigation: enable emergency routing to fallback model variant `rwd-model-small-v2` (quantized, smaller mem footprint). Alice, can you flip routing?

Alice (eng-runtime): Flipping now. Running command:
```bash
redwood route update --service model-runner-prod --policy emergency-fallback --target rwd-model-small-v2
```
Response: routing commit accepted. Traffic shift in progress (5m ramp).

OpsBot: Note: fallback policy applied at 2799991132. Estimated 60% of traffic rerouted.

Dave (eng-sre): Also cordoning gpu-23 and draining its runners to prevent repeat OOMs. `kubectl cordon gpu-23` -> `kubectl drain GPU` in progress.

Alice (eng-runtime): Temp config change applied to reduce per-worker concurrency: `MAX_CONCURRENCY=1` on affected pools. Restarting runner pods with new env.

SRE Oncall - Ben: Observing metrics—5xx rate dropping from 18% -> 4% within 4 minutes. Latency increases ~120ms for some requests on fallback model. Not ideal but mitigates outage.

Carla (support): Communicated to impacted customers: acknowledged, we have mitigation (fallback to smaller model), ETA for full fix TBD. Customers asked whether outputs change—advise that smaller model may have subtle differences.

Elaine (product): Noting which SLAs may be affected. Tracking affected customers for credits and followup. Please capture which routes and models saw errors.

Alice (eng-runtime): Root-cause hypothesis: a recent kernel/driver update on GPU hosts exposed a memory double-free in the quantized attention kernel under high token counts. Repro locally with stress test: `tox --stress --tokens 6k --threads 16` leads to segfault in quant-kernel.

SRE Oncall - Ben: Next steps: 1) Keep fallback routing until a safe hotfix or rollback is in place. 2) Rebuild model runner with mitigations (disable quant-kernel fast-path) and deploy to a small canary. 3) If canary is stable, roll forward and re-route. 4) If not, continue using fallback and schedule kernel rollback on affected fleet.

Dave (eng-sre): I'm taking host remediation: will repro on a staging machine, then either apply a driver rollback or disable the offending kernel at runtime. Will update in 20m.

SRE Oncall - Ben: Handoff: I'm going to stay on the line for 30m then hand to Dave for the rest of the window. Ben will own customer comms for next 15m then hand to Carla. Assigning postmortem owner: Alice (eng-runtime).

IncBot: Incident declared P1 at 2799991115. Playbook: `runtime-oom-segfault` invoked.

Alice (eng-runtime): Canary image built with `QUANT_FASTPATH=0` and deployed to canary pool. Smoke tests passed (no segfaults on 6k token stress). Requesting canary traffic 2% -> 10%.

SRE Oncall - Ben: Approving canary ramp. Monitoring for 10m.

OpsBot: Metrics: 5xx at 2799991195 = 3.6%, median latency on fallback model +130ms.

Dave (eng-sre): Host remediation update: kernel/driver rollback scheduled on 3 affected hosts during the 5m maintenance window; cordoned hosts will not receive rolling updates.

Carla (support): Sent update to customers: mitigation in place, fallback engaged; ETA for full fix ~2-3 hours pending canary and orchestration. Customers asked for timeline for postmortem.

Elaine (product): Collecting customer list for SRE billing/credits team.

SRE Oncall - Ben: After canary validates, we'll either roll the hotfix or keep fallback until next deploy. I'll file a brief incident summary and hand to Dave for PdM/ops follow-up.

Alice (eng-runtime): Preliminary blameless notes: regression likely introduced by driver+kernel+quant fastpath interaction. Postmortem to include reproducer, mitigation options (fallback, concurrency limit), and long-term: guardrails in model onboarding to avoid aggressive quant fastpaths without staged rollout.

SRE Oncall - Ben: Handoff to Dave for remediation and long tail. Ben out after 30m.

Dave (eng-sre): Taking over. Will update channel when hosts are back and when we either roll forward or keep fallback permanently.

IncBot: Incident P1 status updated: mitigation applied, customer impact reduced. Next update expected in 30m. :thumbsup:
